children: PVH delivered second-quarter 2026 revenue of $2.097 billion and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.70, with non-GAAP operating margin of 11.1%, both above guidance. GAAP results included a $439 million pre-tax goodwill impairment, while non-GAAP results benefited from approximately $107 million of tariff refunds. The company reaffirmed its full-year 2026 non-GAAP guidance for revenue (approximately flat), operating margin (~8.8%) and EPS ($11.80–$12.10).
Revenue: $2,097.0 million for Q2 2026 (decreased 3% year-over-year; decreased 3% constant currency).
Gross profit: $1,321.8 million for Q2 2026; gross margin 63.0% (includes ~510 bps benefit from $107 million tariff refunds).
Operating (loss) / income: GAAP EBIT $(190.9) million; non-GAAP EBIT $232.6 million for Q2 2026.
Net (loss) income: GAAP net loss $(102.9) million; non-GAAP net income $171.9 million for Q2 2026.
Diluted net income per share (non-GAAP): $3.70 for Q2 2026 (GAAP diluted loss per share $(2.23)).
Direct-to-consumer (DTC) momentum: DTC revenue approximately flat year-over-year; owned and operated digital commerce grew 4% (3% constant currency), led by Americas and EMEA.
Regional performance: Americas revenue down 1%; APAC revenue up 3% (1% constant currency); EMEA revenue decreased 6% with wholesale softness and store declines offsetting digital growth.
Brand performance: Tommy Hilfiger revenue approximately flat; Calvin Klein revenue down 7% reflecting wholesale shipment timing impacts in Americas.
Channel shifts: Wholesale revenue decreased 6% year-over-year; transition in-house of previously licensed TOMMY HILFIGER women’s categories contributed to Americas revenue mix.

Marketing and partnerships: Launched global campaigns (Calvin Klein: Jung Kook, Raphinha; TOMMY HILFIGER: Liverpool FC and Cadillac F1 Team) and reported stepped-up Q3 marketing investments to support fall season momentum.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
